task.title: Core: tree action in contract, service and capabilities, with tests
task.description: Add the read-only v2 Metaproject action `tree` exactly as plan.md section 'Contract (Core ...)' specifies: request parsing in parseV2 (exact keys, scope graph|wiki, optional parent/cursor/expectedSnapshotId), response types MetaprojectTreeV2 / MetaprojectTreeEntry, `tree` added to METAPROJECT_CAPABILITIES, and the service implementation in metaproject-explorer-v2.ts (graph scope: folders containing indexed file nodes with file counts and the module node of a module folder, then file nodes, sorted, never symbols; wiki scope: page-type groups at the root, pages under a group; paging with METAPROJECT_PAGE_SIZE_V2 and the snapshot-bound cursor helpers; not-found for unknown parent; graph not built -> entries [] and partial true). v1 parsing and responses must not change. Write the tests in the new file src/integrations/metaproject-explorer-tree.test.ts, using the fixture style of src/integrations/metaproject-explorer.test.ts, covering AC1 and AC2 (including the failure scenarios), and keep src/integrations/metaproject-explorer.test.ts passing.

acceptance_criteria: AC1: A v2 `tree` request with `scope: "graph"` returns, for the root and for any folder, the folders containing indexed files (sorted, with file counts, a module folder carrying its module node) followed by that folder's file nodes (sorted), never symbols; pages of at most 100 entries chain by `nextCursor` to the full child list with no duplicate or missing entry; `scope: "wiki"` returns page-type groups at the root and a group's pages under it. [verify: exec `bun test src/integrations/metaproject-explorer-tree.test.ts`]

AC2: Malformed `tree` requests (unknown keys, bad scope, absolute or `..` parent, bad cursor) answer `invalid-input`; an unknown parent answers `not-found`; a cursor or `expectedSnapshotId` from another snapshot answers `stale-snapshot`; `capabilities` lists `tree`; v1 requests parse and answer exactly as before. [verify: exec `bun test src/integrations/metaproject-explorer-tree.test.ts src/integrations/metaproject-explorer.test.ts` · sensitive: failure-scenario]
